LADANG CHENGAL - FACT PACK (Far East Holdings Berhad, Far East group). Estate Manager En. Mohd Zaeh Bin Mat Zin; Regional Senior Manager En. Musa Bin Abdul Halim; Deputy COO / Plantation Controller En. Nazaruddin Bin Hashim.

SOURCES. (1) PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisory), visit 30 June 2026, period January to May 2026, Planting Advisor Tn. Mohd Sufian Bin Yusoff; previous PA visit 11 December 2025 (PA 2/2025, Jan-Nov 2025). Checked against the May estate progress report. (2) Agronomy Report 1/2026, visit 11 February 2026, En. Alison Janari (Junior Agronomist) and Chong Kuan Ming (Senior Agronomist); previous visit 18 September 2025 (Agro 2/2025). Earlier: PA 1/2025 (23 Jun 2025, Jan-May 2025), Agro 1/2025 (19 Mar 2025).

AREA (PA 1/2026 Table 1, May 2026). Total 2,200.00 ha. Mature 1,794.00 ha: P05A 295.90 (2005, DxP Chemara), P06B 335.80 (2006, Chemara), P07C 373.50 (2007, Felda), P08D 247.80 (2008), P08E 216.70 (2008), P10F 191.10 (2010), P10G 133.20 (2010). Replanting P26H 20.20 ha (P26H1 9.10 ha ex-P10G, P26H2 11.10 ha ex-P08E, Felda 3-way). Buildings 11.00 ha, unplantable fields D-G 48.10 ha, unplantable converted area 326.70 ha. Planted 1,814.20 ha. Field tables and yields still use 1,814.20 ha (P08E 227.80, P10G 142.30). PA prints 136 SPH (converted); Agro GIS census Jan 2026: 256,596 palms, average 141 SPH (P05A 160, P06B 136, P07C 148, P08D 141, P08E 123, P10F 138, P10G 132). Palms 8-19 years 65%, 20-25 years 35%. Terrain hilly with terraces plus flood-prone low-lying areas.

CROP (PA 1/2026 Table 18). Jan-May 2026 FFB 10,564.78 t = 5.82 t/ha vs budget 14,000.00 t (7.72 t/ha), 25% below; same period 2025 13,372.35 t (7.37 t/ha), 21% lower. Annual budget 39,000 t (21.50 t/ha). CPO 2,081.50 t, OER 19.70% (budget 19.17%), kernel 528.24 t, KER 5.00%. 2025 actual 12 months 39,917.01 t, 22.00 t/ha, OER 19.42%. By field Jan-May 2026 (t/ha): P05A 5.68, P06B 5.70, P07C 6.75, P08D 6.19, P08E 4.78, P10F 5.09, P10G 6.00; bunches/palm 2.17, average bunch weight 19.74 kg. FFB tonnes Jan-May 2026: P05A 1,682.06, P06B 1,913.74, P07C 2,519.74, P08D 1,534.02, P08E 1,087.96, P10F 973.56, P10G 853.70.

YIELD HISTORY (t/ha, full years). 2019 19.53, 2020 21.55, 2021 18.44, 2022 17.69, 2023 17.22, 2024 21.07 (PA 1/2025 App 4), 2025 22.00 (Agro 1/2026). Tonnes: 2023 31,248; 2024 38,227.44; 2025 39,917.01. 2025 by field (Agro Table 20): P05A 24.31, P06B 22.84, P07C 22.47, P08D 23.60, P08E 19.46 (-4%, flooding), P10F 17.85 (lowest, neglected hilly palms, poor access), P10G 20.87. January 2026 1.69 t/ha vs 1.31 (+22%). Jan-Nov 2025 36,392.65 t (20.06 t/ha) per PA 2/2025.

COST (PA 1/2026 Table 21, Jan-May 2026, RM per t FFB). General charges 104.49 (budget 100.82), upkeep & cultivation 169.89 (144.04), harvesting & collection 80.83 (93.51); total ex-estate 355.21 vs 338.36, 5% over because of the low crop; upkeep overspend mainly roads. Per ha: general charges RM608.51 vs RM803.72 (24% under); upkeep RM989.31 vs RM1,111.55. Upkeep RM/ha (actual vs budget): weeding 124.71/120.00, manuring 543.80/722.37 (25% under, late application), pest & disease 44.42/56.05, census & thinning 8.65/5.19, drains 11.37/14.51, roads & bridges 167.57/94.96 (+76%), soil conservation 0.94/3.45, boundaries 10.03/15.43, tools 1.50/4.48, pruning 76.32/75.12. Harvesting RM52.74/t, internal transport RM28.08/t. General charges overspent: executive vehicle (+10%, diesel), non-exec travelling (+120%, 3 staff transfers), manager bungalow roof (+32%), visiting & HQ (+45%, agronomist and advisory fees), Socso (+15%), recruitment (+100%, RM49.70/ha), sundries (+43%, PPE), MSPO (+85%, boundary survey), ISCC (+34%). 2025 Jan-Nov ex-estate cost RM271.49/t vs budget RM269.97 (PA 2/2025).

LABOUR (PA 1/2026 Table 3, May 2026). 154 workers vs requirement 130 (surplus 24, 1 worker per 12 ha): harvesting 108 vs 82, driver/loader 12 vs 15, weeding 12 vs 12, manuring 9 vs 15, general 10 vs 6, on leave 3. Workers cut from 190 to 154 Jan-May. Ask Regional Office to move surplus to sister estates. Staff: Asst Managers Nazri Bin Abd Hamid and Husin Bin Rosin (transferred Jan 2026); new chief clerk, supervisor and account clerk in 2026.

HARVESTING. 108 harvesters (1 per 17 ha), interval 15 days, 10.00 rounds in 5 months; quality satisfactory, crop sent to mill within 24 hours. Productivity 1.27 t/man-day; average rate RM38.14/t and earnings RM48.59/day, below minimum wage (P08E RM38.85/day lowest, P06B RM57.72 highest). 55 harvesters use 12 crawlers (5.32 t/machine-day, 1.59 t/harvester-day) and 2 Timacs (11.40 t, 1.90 t); the rest wheelbarrows on terraces. Agro: intervals 15-17 days in Jan 2026 but P10G 20 days; 2025 intervals 13-24 days; delayed harvesting in rehabilitated F4, F5, G1, G2; rotten bunches in PM10F-5; ripeness in P05A-6 95-100% ripe.

MANURING. H1 2026 (PA Table 9, to May): required 1,720.95 t, delivered 1,289.25 t, applied 1,165.90 t = 68%; delay from late delivery of May fertiliser (Mix B, NK, Mix A). Productivity 22-30 bags/day, earnings RM75.00-95.00/day. EFB 5,514 t applied in P05A, P06B, P07C at 50 t/ha. 2025 programme completed 100% (2,557.8 t: Mix A 1,726.9, Mix B 401.4, RP 429.5). Agro (Feb): GML pending 1-2 months in P08D and P08E; store wet-floor issue resolved; calibrate bowls. 2026 programme (Agro 1/2026 App 1, g/palm): P05A and P06B Mix A 2,000 Feb and Jul, NK1 2,000 May and Oct, GML 2,000 Aug; P07C Mix A 2,000 Feb, May, Jul, Oct, GML Aug; P08D RP 1,500 Mar, Mix A 8,000 sub-soil Jun-Aug, GML 2,000 Oct; P08E E1-E4 RP 1,500 Mar, Mix A 2,000 Apr, Jun, Aug, Nov (switched to broadcast), GML Oct; P10F and P10G RP 1,500 Mar, Mix B 8,000 sub-soil Feb-May by sub-block, GML 2,000 Oct; replant planting hole RP 500 g + CRF 600 g.

WEEDING. Circle spraying round 1 completed on all 1,814.20 ha; selective 2,675.20 of 3,628.40 ha programmed to May (round 2 in progress). Circles mostly clean; sporadic woody growth and half-dead Clidemia (P07C); keep glyphosate to 2 m radius; premix herbicide; check 2 weeks after spraying; epiphyte spraying in progress. Sprayers 4.50 ha/day circle (RM72.00/day), 4.00 ha/day selective (RM80.00/day).

PESTS AND DISEASES. Rat baiting 722.50 ha Jan-May 2026 (P07C 283.60, P08D 247.80, P10F 191.10; brodifacoum). Dec 2025 census: P08D and P10F at 10% threshold. 190 barn owl boxes (1 per 11 ha), 83% occupied. Bagworm 40 ha treated (Dipel ES), no severe attack; Agro says preventive BT fogging not advisable. Predator plants Cassia/Antigonon/Turnera 60:20:20 advised. No new Ganoderma cases.

PRUNING. Progressive pruning round done on all fields Jan-May 2026; frond stacking to improve in terraces and low-lying areas. 2025 progressive 3 rounds 100%, corrective 93.98 ha done (P06B 41.38, P07C 28.30, P10G 17.00, P10F 5.30, P05A 2.00).

NUTRIENTS (Agro 2/2025 leaf analysis 2025). K and B within range; N, Mg, P and Ca sub-optimal in some sub-blocks; Mg low (L) in P08E E4-E5, P10F F1, F2, F5 and P10G G1-G3. Soil pH mostly 3.6-4.9 (acidic); GML added in 2026 for Mg and low pH. Agro 1/2026: Mg deficiency in hilly PM10F-04/05 and block A, poor vigour in neglected ravines and rehabilitated PM10G-1/2.

FIELD WORKS. Thinning 346 palms removed (runts, close planting). Drains: 900 chains budgeted, desilting with rented machines should be expedited; flooding of 84.13 ha for six days in Dec 2025 (P08E-5). Roads graded 5,478 chains, passable; 520 hours mini-excavator for terraces and paths in P05A and P10F. Boundary 5.54 km surveyed by PARAS GIS team. Mounding of leaning palms (6,982 palms in 2025).

REPLANTING P26H (20.20 ha). Cambered bunds about 22 chains/ha completed on flood-prone ex-P08E and ex-P10G; 148 palms/ha; about 9 ha planted with Yangambi 3-way seedlings from the Dawn nursery by 30 Jun 2026; to finish July 2026; RM1,669.67/ha so far excluding general charges.

CAPEX AND VEHICLES. 2026 capex budget RM2,466,355.00, spent RM237,000.40 (water tank RM45,000; computer RM15,914 vs RM5,000 budget; Toyota Hiace school van RM160,586.40 unbudgeted, HQ approved, Jun 2026). Higer Ace van replaced Jun 2026 after frequent breakdowns.

RAINFALL (mm, days). 2021 2,499.0/131; 2022 2,481.5/122; 2023 3,051.4/144; 2024 2,558.0/111; 2025 2,345.5/101 (Agro; PA omits December); Jan-May 2026 443.0/31. Five-year average about 2,500 mm over 115 days; heavy rain Nov-Feb.

AGRONOMIST VIEW (Agro 1/2026). 2025 yield acceptable and early 2026 promising; key limits for P08E, P10F, P10G: crop loss in previously neglected areas, hilly access, flooding. 2026 programme reviewed with no amendments; P08E E1-E4 switched from sub-soil to broadcast.
